styles.name: 拼多多干净棚拍
styles.lighting: 左上柔光，中性冷调，色温约 5200K
styles.typography: 端正现代几何无衬线（SemiBold 600）+ 10px 圆角莫兰迪柔雾胶囊短签，严禁红黄爆炸贴与粗描边
styles.whitespace: 主图留白 ≥20%，卖点信息图留白 ≥45%
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: consistent womenswear ecommerce set; seamless off-white background #F7F5F2 (detail screens may alternate with soft warm oat #EFECE6 for visual rhythm); charcoal text #2D2D2D; warm taupe Morandi accent #8C6A56; neutral-cool soft studio light from upper left (5200K); upright modern geometric sans-serif short labels in soft 10px rounded-pill capsules only; garment identity locked to the product photo; generous whitespace; no red/yellow starburst stickers, no thick black text strokes, no palette drift, no mixed fonts, no random locations, no extra logos.

styles.name: 淘宝暖调生活
styles.lighting: 暖窗光或暖棚灯，色温约 4500K
styles.typography: 优雅高对比衬线主标题 + 现代无衬线短签，配细香槟金装饰线
styles.whitespace: 主图留白 ≥25%，详情信息图留白 ≥45%
styles.anti_ai_tips: 真实织物垂坠与自然微折痕，保留皮肤真实纹理与发丝微动（natural hair flyaway），禁止过度磨皮或塑料光泽（NOT airbrushed, NOT plastic skin）。
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: warm womenswear lifestyle set; cream background #F5EFE6 (alternating with warm oat #EBE2D5 on detail screens); deep brown text #3A2F27; champagne gold accent #C4A574; warm window-like light at 4500K; refined serif headline with clean sans-serif labels; same room logic across the set; natural fabric drape and real skin texture; no cold blue cast, no mixed third font, no extra logos.

styles.name: Amazon 白底主图
styles.lighting: 均匀棚光，色温 5500K，阴影极淡
styles.typography: 首图无字，主图合规；A+ 副图用经典英文衬线标题配无衬线短词组
styles.garment_scale: 服装填充 85% 以上，四周安全边；信息图占 45–55%
styles.whitespace: 首图纯白背景 #FFFFFF 留白 15%，A+ 信息图留白 ≥48%
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: Amazon-ready womenswear packshot; true white background #FFFFFF (secondary A+ screens may use #F7F7F7); deep black text #111111; even 5500K studio lighting; product fills 85% of the frame with small safety margin; no props, no lifestyle room on hero, no badges on hero, no readable promotional text on hero, no extra logos.

styles.name: 小红书清新
styles.typography: 买手店种草风，少字大字，一种现代几何无衬线
styles.anti_ai_tips: 模拟真实相机或 iPhone 15 Pro 实拍质感，保留真实皮肤毛孔、自然发丝与衣料织纹，拒绝 AI 磨皮假脸（NOT retouched, NOT smoothed, no flawless/hyper-realistic AI look）。
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: fresh Xiaohongshu womenswear; airy cool daylight; pale mint-grey environment #F3F6F4 (secondary #E8EFEA); dark charcoal text #2A2A2A; one sage accent #7A9E8A; natural unretouched skin; short labels only in one sans-serif; no glitch effects, no heavy makeup look, no cluttered stickers, no extra logos.

styles.name: 杂志编辑风
styles.lighting: 方向明确的塑形光，可有轮廓光
styles.typography: 若有字只用一种几何无衬线（Inter/SF Pro 风格）或 Didot 衬线主标，最多 2 种字体
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: editorial womenswear magazine set; sculpted directional light; muted stone set #EDEAE4 (secondary #E2DDD5); deep ink text #1A1A1A; generous negative space; fashion-photography grain optional and consistent; no coupon badges, no mixed fonts, no extra logos.

styles.name: 深色奢感
styles.lighting: 伦勃朗式侧光，暗部有细节
styles.typography: 细无衬线或高对比衬线，极少字
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: dark luxury womenswear; deep brown-black set #1A1714 (secondary #26211D); warm ivory text #F4EFE6; warm rim light; champagne accent #C4A574; rich fabric texture; no neon, no busy pattern backgrounds, no extra logos.

styles.name: 校园青年女装
styles.lighting: 树荫或窗边软日光，皮肤干净通透
styles.typography: 少字，一种端正无衬线 + 圆角浅底短标签
styles.anti_ai_tips: 青年女大学生真实自然状态，发丝与棉质 T 恤/卫衣纹理清晰，不油腻、不假白、不网红浓妆。
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: youthful campus womenswear for young adult female models (college-age, not children); airy daylight; cream-grey set #F4F1EA (alternating with #EAE5DC on detail cards); charcoal text #2C2C2C; natural light makeup; casual tee and hoodie fabrics; one product-matched accent; same daylight across the set; no schoolchild uniform, no over-sexy posing, no mixed fonts, no extra logos.

styles.name: 买家秀街拍种草
styles.lighting: 下午自然漫射光或室内日常光，不打硬棚灯
styles.typography: 无字，或极简买手笔记原生感短标签
styles.anti_ai_tips: Shot on iPhone 15 Pro, Kodak Portra 400 color feel; 保留真实皮肤毛孔、发丝微动（natural hair flyaway）、轻微环境生活痕迹与自然衣料折痕；明确声明 NOT studio lighting, NOT retouched, NOT smoothed；禁用 flawless, hyper-realistic, stunning 等 AI 词汇。
styles.style_lock: Campaign Style Lock: authentic UGC street-style womenswear look; shot on iPhone 15 Pro with Kodak Portra 400 color feel; warm daylight #F2EFE9 (#E7E2D8 secondary); charcoal text #2B2B2B; natural unretouched skin pores and realistic garment creases; NOT studio lighting, NOT retouched, NOT airbrushed; no fake bokeh balls, no promotional stickers, no extra logos.
